data.name: Eshanshay
data.gender_notes: Eshanshay is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Eshan refers to the divine presence. Shay is a form of the god Shiva, symbolizing grace and bestowal. Eshanshay represents the blessings and divine grace bestowed upon an individual. The name Eshanshay carries the meaning “God's gift, divine grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Eshanshay usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift, divine grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Eshanshay belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's gift, divine grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eshanshay total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
